settings.title: Three things.
settings.text: Three short lines before the day starts. A year later the app hands the entry back to you on the same date.

settings.title: Tap a vibe.
settings.text: Six levels, always as icons, never as numbers. Tap as often as you like. The line is your seven-day average.

settings.title: Sit.
settings.text: Log a sit, with your Oura ring if you wear one. The grid shows every day you sat and wrote.

settings.title: A real journal.
settings.text: Photos, links, video, search. Bring your Day One journal with you and keep every entry.

settings.title: No credit card.
settings.text: Make an account and start. Nothing to cancel.

settings.title: No pings, no feed.
settings.text: No notifications, no streak guilt, nobody to follow.

settings.title: Nothing is public.
settings.text: Your journal is yours. Nothing is visible to anyone unless you choose to publish it.

settings.title: Free now.
settings.text: The Calm Shelf helps pay for the app.
